onboarding.title: Welcome to PlantPal
onboarding.intro: Before you get started, PlantPal needs a couple of permissions:
onboarding.cameraDesc: Photograph your plants and track their growth over time.
onboarding.notificationsDesc: Get reminded when it's time to water a plant that's due.
onboarding.note: You can change these later from your device settings, or disable reminders any time from Settings inside the app.
onboarding.permissionDeniedMessage: You can enable camera and photo access later from your device settings to add plant photos.

auth.passwordTooShort: Password should be at least 6 characters.
auth.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Log In
auth.enterEmailFirstResend: Enter your email above first, then tap "Resend confirmation email"
auth.checkEmailVerify: Check your email to verify your account, then log in.
auth.confirmationSent: Confirmation email sent. Check your inbox.
auth.errorUserExists: An account with this email already exists. Try logging in instead.

auth.errorWeakPassword: Password should be at least 6 characters.

auth.errorEmailNotConfirmed: Please verify your email before logging in.
auth.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.sentMessage: Password reset email sent. Check your inbox for a link to set a new password.

dashboard.title: My Plants
dashboard.emptySubtitle: Add your first plant from the Add Plant tab

plantForm.errorNameTooLong: Plant name must be {{max}} characters or fewer.
plantForm.errorSpeciesTooLong: Species must be {{max}} characters or fewer.
plantForm.errorIntervalRange: Watering interval must be between 1 and {{max}} days.
plantForm.cameraPermissionRequired: Camera permission is required to take a photo.
plantForm.libraryPermissionRequired: Photo library permission is required to choose a photo.
plantForm.notAPlant: Couldn't recognize a plant in that photo — you can still enter the species yourself.
plantForm.identifyImageTooLarge: That photo is too large to identify. Try a smaller photo.

plantForm.identifyUnavailable: Couldn't identify the plant right now. Try again, or enter the species yourself.

settings.title: Settings
settings.reminderDescAvailable: Get notified when a plant actually needs water, checked periodically in the background
settings.reminderDescUnavailable: Requires a development build (not supported in Expo Go)
settings.testScheduledMessage: A test notification will arrive in about 5 seconds.
settings.notificationPermissionReminders: Enable notifications in your device settings to get watering reminders.
settings.notificationPermissionTest: Enable notifications in your device settings to receive a test notification.
settings.logoutConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to log out?
settings.deleteAccountMessage: This permanently deletes every plant and photo you've stored (locally and in the cloud) and signs you out. Your login itself is not deleted — you can sign back in afterwards to an empty account.

alerts.expoGoUnavailableMessage: Notifications need a development build on this platform (Expo Go removed support in SDK 53+). Build with EAS to use this feature.

confirmDelete.deletePlantMessage: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"?

errors.permissionDenied: You don't have permission to do that.

notifications.testBody: If you see this, notifications are working.

chat.title: Plant Care Chat
chat.emptyState: Ask me anything about watering, light, pests, or plant care in general.
chat.errorNoKey: AI chat isn't set up yet.
chat.errorRateLimited: You've hit the AI chat's usage limit for now. Try again in a little while.
chat.errorInvalidKey: AI chat isn't configured correctly (invalid API key).
chat.errorNetwork: Couldn't reach the AI service. Check your internet connection and try again.
chat.clearChatMessage: This permanently deletes this conversation. This can't be undone.
chat.systemPromptBase: You are a helpful, concise plant care assistant inside the PlantPal app. Answer questions about watering, light, soil, pests, and general plant care. Keep answers short and practical. Reply in plain text only — no Markdown, no asterisks, no headings, no code formatting.
chat.systemPromptPlantContext: The user is asking about a specific plant they own: name "{{name}}", species {{species}}, watered roughly every {{intervalDays}} days.
